descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · S20 Guardrail by PII entity and expected action, on production and on the UAT deployment

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 The guardrail configuration (ADDRESS/PHONE = None) and the model ID are version-pinned in production and match what UAT ran on. (UAT OAT-05; UAT 3.1; TFA-94059 AC 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-94059 in progress
  • T3 Every AI call, including Ask AI and Handoff, goes out from server-side Convex actions with the Bedrock guardrail applied. (TFA-92568 AC 13; TFA-92568 Eng 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given The guardrail and version each deployment uses (BEDROCK_GUARDRAIL_ID and VERSION), read with 'aws bedrock get-guardrail' by Tim, and infra/stacks/aws.ts at the deployed commit

When Fill the table, one row per entity: PHONE, ADDRESS, EMAIL, SSN, card. Columns: action on production, action on the UAT deployment, action in infra code. Add the version type (numbered or DRAFT), whether BEDROCK_GUARDRAIL_ID and BEDROCK_GUARDRAIL_VERSION are set on each deployment's Convex env (names only; …

Then PHONE and ADDRESS are None on production, on the UAT deployment and in infra code. The other entities are the same on both deployments. The guardrail ID and version are set on both. The version is numbered and published. Bedrock refuses invocation without the guardrail.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT OAT-05 step 7 and UAT 3.1 (ADDRESS/PHONE actions set to None); TFA-92568 AC 13 (guardrail applied). PHONE or ADDRESS other than None on either deployment, or in the infra code that would restore it, is a Fail. A config that differs between production and UAT is a Fail. DRAFT and the other entities are judged per Q6.

Where it ran: dev; test method CONFIG · Config check; lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S20 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-05.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: CONFIG · Config check; secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on dev; Source: dev.
